name: Haptic Button Set
hint: Press and hold the send button: feel a soft tick at each quarter and a heavy thud at the end. Then drag Slide to pay, tap Verify, and tap Cancel twice.
description: A set of React Native buttons where each style has its own motion and its own haptic pattern, shown as a send-money review screen. Hold to send fills on a UI-thread clock while you hold it, with a soft tick at each quarter, a heavy thud at the end and a success pulse as it turns green and draws a check; let go early and it drains back on a spring. Plain buttons squash on press and spring back with a light tap. The segmented speed chips and the Split the bill and Repeat monthly toggles give a selection tick, with a fill that stretches between options. Slide to pay has a draggable thumb that rubber-bands past either end, ticks at each mark and pays at the end. The async Verify button folds into a spinner and lands on a drawn check, or shakes red on a decaying spring with an error haptic. Cancel transfer asks first: the first tap gives a warning haptic and stretches into Tap again to cancel transfer, and the second commits. Every hold and slide also works as a screen-reader action.
intents: hold to confirm button with haptic feedback
slide to confirm payment button react native
button haptics for each button type
async loading button with success and error states
usage: Match the haptic to what the button commits: a light tap for plain actions, a selection tick for choices, soft ticks building to a heavy thud for a hold, success or error only for real outcomes, and a warning before anything destructive. Save hold and slide for irreversible money moves, always keep a screen-reader action for them, and never fire a success haptic before the server confirms.
